title: Isolated Astrocyte Culture Protocol
author: Yasmin Bar El
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tqcemsw
materials: 1. Chopp with scissors in a papain-based dissociation buffer (2.5 mM CaCl2, 0.83 mM EDTA, 137 U papain (Sigma-Aldrich)), 100 μl DNAse (Sigma-Aldrich), 3–5 crystals of L-Cysteine (Sigma-Aldrich), HBSS with 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.4); 2. Place on a rotating shaker for 15 min 00:15:00 at room temperature.
Plate the cells on poly-D-lysine (PDL, Sigma-Aldrich, P7405-5MG) coated T75 flasks;

Re-plate the cells on poly-D-lysine (PDL, Sigma-Aldrich, P7405-5MG) coated micro-electrode arrays (MEAs; 200/30iR-Ti-gr and 500/30iR-Ti-pr; Multichannel Systems) with a cell density of 2000-2500 cells/mm2 (~106 cells per dish).

1. Plate the cells on poly-D-lysine (PDL, Sigma-Aldrich, P7405-5MG) coated T75 flasks; 2. Maintain cultures at 37 °C with 5% CO2. s Replace growth medium every 3-4 days to astrocyte enriched growth medium: MEM-EAGLE (without L-glutamine, with essential amino acids) (Beit Haemek), 3 mg/ml glucose, 10% heat-inactivated fetal calf serum (Biological Industries), 0.8% GlutaMAX (100X; Gibco), 0.5% Pen/Strep, 2 mM glutamine (Beit Haemek); 3. After 20 DIV detache using trypsin/EDTA; 4. Re-plate the cells on poly-D-lysine (PDL, Sigma-Aldrich, P7405-5MG) coated micro-electrode arrays (MEAs; 200/30iR-Ti-gr and 500/30iR-Ti-pr; Multichannel Systems) with a cell density of 2000-2500 cells/mm2 (~106 cells per dish).

steps.title: Dissect cortices and chill
steps.instruction: Dissect cortices from post‑natal day 0 or 1 mouse pups and place the tissue on ice.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet and triturate
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in the complete medium, and triturate the suspension.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in modified essential medium (MEM) without L‑glutamine, supplemented with essential amino acids (Beit Haemek, 06‑1025‑01‑1A), 5 % heat‑inactivated fetal calf serum (Biological Industries), 5 % heat‑inactivated horse serum (Beit Haemek, 04‑004‑1), 2 mM glutamine (Beit Haemek, 03‑020‑1c), 3 mg/ml glucose, 2 % B‑27 (Gibco, 17504‑044), and 0.5 % Pen/Strep (100 U/ml penicillin, 100 μg/ml streptomycin; Beit Haemek, 03‑031‑1B).
